practiceReport.name: Jake Ferguson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: Officially ruled Out on weekly game status report
practiceReport.beatComment: As expected, Ferguson will be sidelined for a third straight game after he failed to practice in any fashion this week while continuing to tend to a pair of lower-body injuries. Brevyn Spann-Ford will be in line for another turn as the Cowboys' top tight end while Ferguson is sidelined. After the Thanksgiving Day contest, the Cowboys will face a longer turnaround for Week 13 with a Dec. 7 matchup against the Seahawks, and Ferguson should have decent odds of making it back for that game.

practiceReport.name: Dak Prescott
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran franchise QB; plays through upper-extremity soreness while lower-body soft-tissue tags carry elevated caution.
practiceReport.beatComment: As the final score and Prescott's numbers indicate, the prolific passer was clicking on all cylinders right out of the gate against an overmatched Titans defense. Prescott had already helped stake the Cowboys to a 27-6 lead by halftime with eight- and 10-yard touchdown strikes to CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens, respectively. Prescott struck again through the air in the second half with an 11-yard touchdown pass to Javonte Williams before closing out his touchdown tally with a two-yard toss to Brevyn Spann-Ford with just under five minutes remaining. Prescott added his second rushing touchdown of the campaign on a two-yard run in the latter portion of the third quarter, giving him his second straight five-TD performance. Prescott is up to 3,049 passing yards and a 25:6 TD:INT heading into a Thanksgiving Day home clash with the Eagles in Week 12.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Malachi Lawrence
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Lawrence suffered an ankle injury last Sunday in a loss to Arizona and had already been ruled out for Week 9. The move to IR means he'll need to miss at least three additional games, so the earliest Lawrence can return is Monday, Dec. 7, against Seattle. The Cowboys activated fellow linebacker Marist Liufau (forearm) from IR on Saturday to fill Lawrence's roster spot.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Tyler Goodson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 14 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: The move comes as no surprise, seeing as Goodson is expected to miss multiple games due to ACL and MCL sprains in his knee that he suffered during the Cowboys' Week 9 victory over the Colts. With Malik Davis (hip, IR) out for the year and Goodson now on IR, Israel Abanikanda -- who was elevated from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday -- will serve as Dallas' RB2 behind Javonte Williams for Sunday's game against the 49ers. Goodson is required to miss at least four games while on IR, so his next chance to play is Week 15 against the Rams on Sunday, Dec. 20.

irAndReserveTracker.name: DaRon Bland
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Bland was placed on injured reserve Sunday after suffering an ankle injury during the Week 10 loss to the 49ers, but the injury is not expected to be season-ending. The earliest Bland will be eligible to make his return is the Week 16 matchup versus Jacksonville, and Ameer Speed and Cobie Durant should continue to see increased playing time in his absence.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Kelvin Gilliam Jr.
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Gilliam is set to remain with the Cowboys after clearing waivers, albeit on injured reserve. The 23-year-old will now be forced to miss the entirety of the upcoming campaign unless he's waived with an injury settlement.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Malik Davis
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Davis underwent surgery Saturday for a hip injury, and Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News reports that the procedure will sideline the 27-year-old running back for the entire 2026 season. With Davis on the shelf, the Cowboys bolstered their backfield depth by signing Israel Abanikanda from the practice squad to the active roster, with the latter serving as the RB3 behind Javonte Williams and Emari Demercado.
